senses.gloss: f. (πανδοῦρα, v. Hesych. s. v.) pandean pipe (syrinx), the shepherd’s pipe. Y. B. Bath. VII, end, 15ᵈ נותן לו כמין פ׳ he must give him a portion of his field in the shape of a syrinx (a quadrangle one side of which is half as long as its opposite). Ib. III, beg. 13ᵈ (expl. מַשְׁכּוֹכִיתָא) אית דמרין פ׳ (ed. Krot. פנדודה, corr. acc.) some say, the deliverance of the shepherd’s pipe (as symbolical possession); Y. B. Kam. X, end, 7ᶜ (expl. ברחא), v. שַׁרְקוּקִיתָא.
